definitions.explanation: Putting one's life on the line; doing something with total commitment as if one's life depended on it. Used both literally and figuratively.

examples.japanese: {命懸|いのちが}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げた→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧。
⟦{消防士|しょうぼうし}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{命懸|いのちが}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: The firefighters risked their lives in the rescue operation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{命懸|いのちが}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: He entered the match with life-or-death determination.

notes:
Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, or directly modifies verbs as an adverb (e.g., {命懸|いのちが}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{戦|たたか}う→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧). Also written as {命|いのち}がけ in hiragana for the second part.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {命懸|いのちが}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ — to protect at the risk of one's life
- {命懸|いのちが}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧ — a life-or-death battle
- {命懸|いのちが}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧ — life-or-death resolve
- {命懸|いのちが}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逃|に}げる→逃げる：01151_nigeru⟧ — to flee for one's life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧ — desperate, frantic (more common in everyday use)
- {決死|けっし} — do-or-die (literary, often used with ⟦{覚悟|かくご}→覚悟：02551_kakugo⟧)
